title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’80s show with killer Spanish Jam and a monster Other One, captured on a muddy but still listenable recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the fire‑filled second set – Spanish Jam, El Paso, Good Times, Scarlet>Fire, Terrapin and an epic Other One that even got Phil pulling a four‑string bass riff.  The performance is described as “smoking” and “tremendous,” while the tape’s sound is noted as muddy but ultimately enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 4‑ or 5‑star and praise the musical performance; only one mentions muddy sound, which lowers the technical score but not enough to outweigh the strong show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several listeners note a muddy, slightly muffled tape sound (possible cassette source), but no severe drop‑outs; overall still listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as nearly flawless with smooth transitions (Scarlet>Fire, Terrapin) and high‑octane jams; overall set praised for energy and pacing.

band_member_comments.Phil: Playing a four‑string bass and delivering the opening riff to The Other One, noted as a big difference.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s soulful keyboard work is highlighted as a highlight of the performance.
